_what: C-9 MIX v3 -- her DEFAULT Meteor (Matt, 2026-09-30 second correction) and the COLD-FIRST-LOAD fix (the coordinator: the veil gated on completed warm-ups, an 8 s responsive cap, a 'preparing effects…' line, staged first draw). drax.

build.fall: lane B's travel down the sun ray, its growing shadow and fall light, with NO separate rock: the comet's head is a ball of fire with a dark, deep core (COMET_SHADER core term: near-black -> deep crimson -> crimson planes at the ball's centre as seen, the hot fire planes kept as its rim), the tail lighter and wispier (tail_wisp: more tearing, lifted values)
build.impact: lane A's painted burst UNCHANGED (MIX v2's meteor_mix2 frames, byte-identical to lane A's proven atlas), B's flash, fire light on the characters and the shake
build.crater: godot/scripts/crater_fx.gd: the snow pressed with its berm (SnowField._stamp, the boot's own stamp: the dent and its raised rim are real snow geometry) and a CRATER SKIN draped on the dented ground (17x17 grid, one unshaded shader): the bowl lit by the sun with the painter's shadow colour on the turned wall, the raised lip, soot in two flat torn washes, 7 radial fault lines + a net of cell cracks inked, each with a LINE OF FIRE cooling over ~5 s, 1-2 runners past the rim seen mostly while burning, a smouldering centre glowing deep red and pulsing (cool by ~6.5 s); the cooled crater stays; a pool of 4, the oldest faded when the pool is full
build.warp: a radial lens pull centred on the impact folded into the post pass's own screen copy (PaintStack POST_SHADER, global fx_warp; no extra pass): begins 0.10 s before impact, peaks at impact, gone by +0.15 s; profile peak about 2.9 px at 1080 rows

head_vs_tail._: tools/head_tail.py, 40 fall frames, play camera, phone look: head = the ball's disc, tail = 1.6-4.5 radii behind

proof.impact_frames: unchanged from MIX v2 (236 frames byte-identical to lane A's proven atlas, worst 0.92/255)
proof.new_3d: the ball's core, the crater and the warp are runtime 3D/shader work: stills and film, no flipbook proof applies

cold_first_load._: Chrome with a fresh Playwright profile AND Chrome's Metal shader cache (DARWIN_USER_CACHE_DIR/com.google.Chrome.helper/com.apple.metal) moved aside before each cold run; 844x390 CSS px at DPR 3; ANGLE Metal on the M2

her_page.veil: lifted by the 3 s cap mid-compile

fix: the veil lifts only when every warm-up has COMPLETED (its draw issued and drawn) and then 8 frames run under 25 ms
its cap counts RESPONSIVE waiting only (frames under 250 ms; a compile stall is the work it waits for), 8 s, with a 45 s wall-clock backstop

on the web the veil is also a DOM overlay over the canvas (the browser keeps compositing it while the engine is blocked); its 'preparing effects…' line fades in after 3 s by a CSS animation the compositor runs
STAGED first draw: at ready the level's visible geometry is hidden and given back one SHADER per frame (every node sharing a shader with it), so the compiles spread over many frames
the Meteor's painted-surface fx variants warmed one KIND per frame (painted, snow, heather, char), after the staging (they compile only where the surfaces draw)
the perf harness's clock starts at the veil's lift (a player cannot cast under it)
cold_first_load.residual: one frame of about 3.9 s (her page) / 2.7 s (his) remains under the veil: the painted ground's one large shader compiling, which no staging can split; the DOM line covers it. A phone GPU will be slower

budget._: delta against a matched control, 20 chop casts 6 s apart alternating, no screenshots in timed windows; fx time = MeteorFx + A's burst + the crater
budget.FINDING_pipeline_lesson: rebuilding the crater skin's mesh at impact (clear_surfaces + add_surface_from_arrays) cost a 40-60 ms draw frame on EVERY desktop cast (a new GPU buffer and pipeline per surface); writing the heights into the skin's own dynamic vertex buffer (ARRAY_FLAG_USE_DYNAMIC_UPDATE + mesh_surface_update_vertex_region) took the warm max to 21.6-24 ms. Never rebuild a mesh at cast time; update a dynamic buffer

film: Desktop review folder: 'C-9 sorceress Meteor MIX v3 - ball of fire with dark core, A painted impact, crater, warp - play speed then quarter speed.mp4' and two stills (the fall; the warp, burst and crater from -0.1 s to +8 s)
